messages.text:
"Create a highly accurate Flappy Bird recreation. Match the original game's gameplay as closely as possible.

- 2D side-scrolling gameplay.
- Tap or press Space to flap and fly upward.
- Gravity continuously pulls the bird downward.
- Green pipes appear in pairs with gaps to fly through.
- Pipes move from right to left at a consistent speed.
- Collision with pipes or ground ends the game.
- Each successfully passed pipe awards 1 point.
- Gradually increase difficulty.
- Recreate the original pixel-art visual style, sky-blue background, green pipes, ground, bird animations and retro graphics.
- Include the original-style score display, ready screen, game-over screen, restart button and medal system.
- Use simple sound effects and smooth movement.
- Keep the physics, collision detection, timing and controls extremely close to the original.
- Make the game lightweight, using minimal assets and no unnecessary dependencies.
- Ensure the game is fully playable from start to finish and test all mechanics.

Priority: Gameplay accuracy first, visual similarity second, optimization third.
"
